subject: VPC & air-gapped deployment — constraints, goals, and owners (post-call)
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Anita Desai <anita.desai@hearthline.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@hearthline.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: VPC & air-gapped deployment — constraints, goals, and owners (post-call)

Hi Anita / Marco — thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap while everything is fresh and to confirm owners / next steps. I pulled together the three attachments we referenced (network diagram, short private deployment brief, SOC2 evidence request worksheet).

Key business goals you reiterated:
- Keep all inference processing within customer-managed VPCs and restrict egress (no direct internet from inference subnets).
- Meet regulatory requirement: data residency in US-only regions and explicit retention/deletion windows.
- Ability to operate in a physically segregated (air-gapped) mode for high-risk workflows.

Top technical constraints we captured:
- Inference nodes must be placed in private subnets with NAT or controlled egress via approved jump-hosts / proxy — no public IPs on serving instances.
- Long-lived model KV caches may need encrypted disk and HSM integration for key material (KMS/HSM).
- Hardware/ops: you want a single-tenant host (dedicated racks) and an option to physically disconnect from the internet during specific QA windows.
- Monitoring & logging: audit logs and access logs must be exportable to your SIEM; we discussed limited agent footprint on air-gapped environments and a pull-based evidence export process.
- Minimum throughput requirement: 80 qps at p95 latency < 350ms for standard chat prompts.

Open risks we flagged on the call:
- Procurement timeline may push into September if legal requires additional attestation language in the SOW.
- Onboarding timeline depends on whether you require an on-prem installation vs. VPC-hosted private control plane.

Concrete next steps / owners (proposed):
1) IR: Draft a short SOW outline and a hosting-option matrix for VPC vs on-prem (deliver by Fri 6/5).
2) BEN: Coordinate latency and quantization tradeoffs and share a latency vs cost sketch for the 80 qps target (deliver 6/8).
3) MARISSA: Start procurement intro and capture contract required approvals / CLA contacts (deliver contact list 6/9).
4) MARCO: Share network diagram with CIDR ranges and egress policy (if available) and the list of internal PKI/HSM owners (requested by 6/6).

Meeting to schedule: Proposed tech deep-dive with your infra + our runtime team next week — slot link in the footer.

Attachments: hearthline-network-diagram.png, redwood-private-brief.pdf, soc2-evidence-request.xlsx

Thanks — IRENE
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
https://calendly.com/irene-redwood/tech-deepdive
From: Anita Desai <anita.desai@hearthline.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@hearthline.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC & air-gapped deployment — constraints, goals, and owners (post-call)

Irene — thanks for the clear summary. Confirming a few additions from Legal / Compliance we discussed:
- Retention: patient-derived PII must be deleted at 30 days unless flagged; deletion must be auditable with timestamps and requester id.
- We need a high-level data flow diagram (we'll attach ours; Marco will send the internal network CIDRs).
- If we pursue a physically air-gapped option, Legal wants a third-party attestation checklist (SOC2 alone won't be sufficient).

Procurement note: we aim to finalize vendor selection by end of Q3; an early SOW/estimate helps us prioritize internal approvals. Can you include a rough one-time setup estimate for an on-prem option vs VPC-resident private control plane?

I'll loop our security architect in the deep dive if Marco can't answer the PKI/HSM items before 6/6.

--
Anita Desai
Head of Product, Privacy & Compliance — Hearthline Health
Anita.desai@hearthline.com | +1 415 555 0198
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Anita Desai <anita.desai@hearthline.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 4 Jun 2026 08:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VPC & air-gapped deployment — constraints, goals, and owners (post-call)

Thanks — quick internal note and a proposed ask for the tech-deep dive:
- From an inference ops perspective, achieving p95 < 350ms at 80 qps likely requires model batching and either A100-class GPUs or a quantized LLM profile. We'll include two config templates (low-latency / cost-savvy) for comparison.
- Action: Can Marco share representative payload sizes and typical sequence lengths so we can baseline token throughput? That will materially change the hardware recommendation.

I'll take point on the cost vs latency brief and send a short spreadsheet with two scenarios by 6/8. Happy to join the deep-dive and lead the runtime portion.

-ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: VPC & air-gapped deployment — constraints, goals, and owners (post-call)

Appreciate the quick replies — finalizing owners/dates here and confirming the deep-dive schedule:
- IR (Irene): SOW outline + hosting-option matrix — due EOD Fri 6/5 (sheet in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdEFGhijkLmnopQ).
- BEN: Latency / cost scenarios spreadsheet — draft 6/8.
- MARISSA: Procurement contacts and initial contract asks — draft 6/9.
- MARCO (Hearthline): Network CIDRs + PKI/HSM contacts — requested 6/6.

Tech deep-dive: Proposed slots (pick one) — Mon 6/8 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 6/9 14:00-15:00 PT. Calendly link: https://calendly.com/irene-redwood/tech-deepdive

Immediate asks for Hearthline ahead of the deep-dive:
- Representative payload examples (JSON inputs), average and 95th percentile sequence lengths.
- Confirmation whether you can provide a jump host / proxy for outbound egress control or if you expect on-prem isolation.
- Any procurement templates that would accelerate SOW review.

I'll attach the redwood-private-brief.pdf to the Drive folder as well. If anything critical is missing from this recap, flag it in reply and we'll update.

Thanks all — looking forward to the deep dive.

Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
